biggest_catch: Instant pay costs a small fee — the free payout takes a few days, and you need an active healthcare credential to work at all.
catches: Instant Pay within minutes carries a small fee; the free option pays within a few days.
You need an active healthcare license/credential (CNA, LPN, RN, caregiver) — this is not open to the general public.
Shift pay is posted per shift in the app; facilities choose from worker profiles, so thin profiles get fewer shifts.
Attendance and rating issues can limit future shift access.

eligibility: Active healthcare credential (CNA, LPN/LVN, RN, caregiver); onboarding + credentialing through the app.
maximize: Only use paid Instant Pay when you actually need cash tonight — Clipboard's own listing says the free payout lands within a few days, so default to free and pay the small fee only when the money can't wait. Stack the referral bonus: the official site says you get a bonus for every colleague you invite who completes their first shift, so bring coworkers onto the platform and collect on their first shifts too. Book AM, PM, and overnight (NOC) shifts the app lists to keep your calendar full.
